description.value:
You call forth a spectra tasked with monitoring the Drift and presenting its gift to technologically advanced civilizations. The spectra occupies the space of a Large creature, and has a Speed of 40 feet and a fly Speed of 60 feet with the cosmic trait.

Arrive Establish Universal Network With a burst of divine energy from the Drift, the spectra restores @Damage[(5*(@item.level - 1))[healing]|options:area-damage] Hit Points to all creatures or objects with the tech trait within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] and reduces their glitching condition by 5.

Depart Terminate Connection Each creature or attended object with the tech trait within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] must attempt a Fortitude save. On a failed save, the creature or object becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Glitching]{Glitching 5}, and creatures are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} while they're glitching.

Heightened (+1) Increase the Hit Points restored by 5.

target.value: until the end of your next turn
